  • Method Details

    • surface

      public RetailMedia.Builder surface(Placement placement, Surface surface)
      Binds placement to surface. Repeatable, one call per placement, in the order the placements should be considered; at least one is required. A placement bound twice is refused with IllegalArgumentException — a zone has exactly one place to draw.

    • onOffer

      public RetailMedia.Builder onOffer(Consumer<Offer> onOffer)
      Receives every validated Offer the shopper accepted; the register applies it to its own pricing. The only callback the register must act on. Delivered on the session's callback executor. Optional, but a widget without it can show ads and not honour them.

    • onInteraction

      public RetailMedia.Builder onInteraction(Consumer<AdInteraction> onInteraction)
      Receives every shopper-visible ad event as an AdInteraction, for logging or for the register's own screen. Informational; the SDK measures and reports the same events to the platform whether or not the register listens. Delivered on the session's callback executor.

    • adService

      public RetailMedia.Builder adService(AdDecisionService adService)
      The service that registers the session, decides what to show and validates taps. Required in practice in this release: there is no platform-backed default yet, and a widget built without one reports SessionErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED through onBackgroundError at attach and stays inert. Use InMemoryAdDecisionService for tests and the emulator.

    • eligiblePhases

      public RetailMedia.Builder eligiblePhases(Set<CheckoutPhase> eligiblePhases)
      The checkout phases in which media is requested and shown; outside them the surfaces stay clear. Default: every phase except CheckoutPhase.COMPLETE. Must not be empty.

    • decisionTimeout

      public RetailMedia.Builder decisionTimeout(Duration decisionTimeout)
      How long a decision request may take; a slower answer is a miss and the placement stays blank or falls back. Default 500 ms. Must be positive.

    • renderingTtl

      public RetailMedia.Builder renderingTtl(Duration renderingTtl)
      Overrides how long a rendering stays on a surface before it is refreshed, regardless of the TTL the platform put on it. Default: honour each rendering's own Rendering.getTtl(). Must be positive when set.

    • sdkVersion

      public RetailMedia.Builder sdkVersion(String sdkVersion)
      The SDK version reported in Capabilities. Default: this build's version from the bilt-pos-sdk-version.properties resource Gradle generates, e.g. "0.24.1". For a wrapper SDK that wants to report its own release.

    • build

      public RetailMedia build()
      Builds the widget. Fails with IllegalArgumentException when no surface was bound.
